testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect existing feature search criteria: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:595:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect existing feature search criteria ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the MCAD Software Find dialog contains these feature criteria in order: | Property | Condition | Value | Join | | Type | equals | Extrusion | And | | Type | equals | Fillet | Or | | Suppress status | equals | Suppressed | And | ✔ When the user selects the Suppress status criterion ✔ Then the criterion controls show Suppress status, equals and Suppressed ✔ And And is selected ✔ When the user selects the Fillet criterion ✔ Then the criterion controls show Type, equals and Fillet ✔ And Or is selected ✔ When the user selects the Extrusion criterion ✔ Then the criterion controls show Type, equals and Extrusion ✔ And And is selected ✔ And the three criteria remain listed ✔ When the user closes the Find dialog ✔ Then the part workspace is visible
